welcome.employee1Text: Available Work is the marketplace — first valid claim wins. Assigned work waits for your accept/decline.
welcome.employee2Text: Attach files (policy limits apply) and add a note. Self-reported progress is informational; the manager verifies.
welcome.employee3Text: Approvals and accepted partial contributions pay into your wallet. Spend them in Rewards; track everything in Wallet.
welcome.intro: Tasks are economic objects: work flows to review, review flows to Coins. Three things to know:
welcome.manager1Text: Create task — to the marketplace or a specific employee. Watch capacity before assigning.
welcome.manager2Text: Submissions land in Reviews: approve (pays out), reject (rework), or hand off with partial credit.
welcome.manager3Text: Fulfill redemptions, watch the append-only ledger, and set the upload policy in Admin.
